name: Country Club for Business
description:
The Country Club for Business connector brings your sponsorship dashboard into Claude. Ask in plain language and Claude works directly with your Country Club data on your behalf.

With it you can:
• Opportunities — review event opportunities, accept them, stall or resume, and inspect seating and status.
• Target companies — build and manage target-account lists, add notes, set status and owners, and review contacts and recommendations.
• Target suggestions — generate suggested accounts, review the stats behind them, and accept or reject each one.
• Products — create, review, update, and remove products in your catalog.
• Companies & people — search companies, view their employees, and browse or match the people most relevant to you.
• Team — invite and manage team members, and add or remove attendees for each event.

You sign in once with your existing Country Club account over OAuth 2.1 — Claude never sees your password, only sees data your account can access, and asks before any action that changes or removes data. Disconnect anytime to revoke access.

Full documentation: https://country.club/connectors?tab=business

_published_faq.name: How do I add Country Club for Business to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Country Club for Business to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.country.club/business/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Country Club for Business MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Country Club for Business lists 50 MCP tools, including business_companies_employees_list, business_companies_get, business_companies_search, business_me, business_opportunities_cancel_stall, business_opportunities_get, business_opportunities_list, business_opportunities_seating_get, business_opportunities_stall, business_opportunities_state_get, business_opportunities_state_update, and business_people_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Country Club for Business?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Country Club for Business in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Country Club for Business MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Country Club for Business requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Country Club for Business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Country Club for Business is developed by Country club. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
